page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.s2.large is an x86_64 architecture server instance belonging to the ecs.s2 server family. It is provisioned with 2 vCPUs and 2 physical cores, utilizing a dedicated CPU allocation model with 1.0 thread per core. The instance features 4.0 GB of system memory, yielding a memory-to-core ratio of 2.0 GB per core. It operates on the KVM hypervisor.

This server configuration does not include local NVMe or SSD storage, meaning all storage requirements must be met via external network-attached block storage. There are no integrated GPU accelerators, and the instance does not come with complimentary public IPv4 addresses.

With a dedicated CPU allocation and a 1:2 vCPU-to-RAM ratio, the ecs.s2.large offers a predictable but constrained resource profile. The absence of advanced vector extensions (AVX, AVX-512) and cryptographic hardware acceleration limits its suitability for intensive mathematical modeling or high-throughput encryption tasks. From a cost-efficiency perspective, the low resource density makes it an entry-level option for lightweight utility workloads, basic web serving, development environments, and small-scale application hosting that do not require high memory capacity or local disk I/O.
